title: Rename one exported symbol across a tree without touching its look-alikes
prompt: In src/core.js the exported function parsePayload has to be renamed to decodePayload: its definition, every import of it, and every call site. parsePayloadLegacy and parsePayloadAsync are different functions and keep their own names. Change no behaviour, add or remove no file under src/, and leave check.mjs alone. When you are done, node check.mjs must exit 0.
